label: Upstream 0.88.0, with Ken's status pill and smarter Goals workers

sections.title: Upstream 0.87.3 and 0.88.0: in your app
items: You'll never wonder whether `Goals` is still working again. A little storybook pill in the corner of the farm now tells you exactly what Ken is doing, like `Reading search.ts`, with a live timer so even a long think clearly reads as progress. Hover it for one more detail. Ken also pops a thought bubble over his head while he thinks, waits on a command or needs you, and the pill politely steps aside while he's talking or a question card is up, so the farm never gets cluttered.
The `Steroids` page now shows how much disk your code library takes, like `2.0 GB on disk`, right next to your repos and files, and the row lines up cleanly with everything around it.
The power switch in Settings now simply reads `Keep awake`. Your project folder still saves only when you choose `Save folder`, so a half-typed path never replaces the folder you're using.

sections.title: Upstream 0.87.3 and 0.88.0: in your agent
items: Claude `Opus 5.5`, `Sonnet 5.5` and `Haiku 5.5` now start fresh chats at `medium` effort, the same default Anthropic uses, so answers come faster and cost less. Any level you've already picked stays exactly as you set it.

`Goals` workers now build from real code instead of memory. With `Steroids` installed, builders and checkers can look up how real open-source projects actually use a library before they write a line, so the work lands right the first time.
